title: BugDNA Diff
description: Serialized representation of a BugDNA failure fingerprint difference comparison result

summary.description: High-level summary of the architectural or behavioral change (e.g., 'No Fingerprint Change', 'Method Changed', 'Layer Changed', '{Layer} Layer Changed', 'Root Cause Changed', 'Call Path Changed')

oldValue.description: Previous value for the changed dimension

newValue.description: Current value for the changed dimension

explanation.description: Human-readable explanation detailing the difference between the two fingerprints
